meta.title: Our Lisbon weekend
meta.subtitle: Portugal · 3 days · sample trip
meta.routeSummary: Lisbon's old town, Belém, then a day in Sintra and Cascais.

days.title: Arrival & Alfama
days.travel: Airport to Baixa by metro, ~25 min, about €2 with a Viva Viagem card.
days.bags: Keep them with you – short metro ride
steps: Lisbon Airport → Metro Red Line → Alameda → Green Line → Baixa-Chiado
Walk: Praça do Comércio → Alfama → Miradouro de Santa Luzia
days.plan:
• Check in and drop bags
• Sunset at Miradouro de Santa Luzia
• Dinner and fado in Alfama
days.gem: Tram 28 early in the morning before the queues start.
days.morning: • Land and buy a Viva Viagem card at the metro
days.noon:
• Praça do Comércio and the Rua Augusta Arch viewpoint
• ⭐ Castelo de São Jorge for the views
days.evening:
• Fado dinner in Alfama (book ahead)
• Drinks in Bairro Alto
days.food:
• Pastel de Nata at Manteigaria
• Grilled sardines in Alfama
days.shop: • Tinned fish and ceramics in Baixa
days.tips: • Wear shoes with grip – the stone pavements are slippery

days.title: Belém & LX Factory
days.travel: Tram 15E from Praça da Figueira to Belém, ~30 min.
days.plan:
• Jerónimos Monastery
• Belém Tower
• LX Factory in the afternoon
days.gem: MAAT rooftop walkway – free and right on the river.
days.noon:
• Belém Tower and the riverside walk
• LX Factory shops and cafés
days.evening: • Sunset at Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara
days.food: • Pastéis de Belém (the original custard tarts)
days.tips: • Buy the monastery ticket online to skip the queue

days.title: Sintra & Cascais
days.title_en: Day trip: Sintra palaces and the coast
days.travel: Train from Rossio to Sintra, ~40 min; bus 403 via Cabo da Roca to Cascais.
steps: Bus 434 → Pena Palace → Quinta da Regaleira
Cascais Station → train → Cais do Sodré
days.plan:
• Pena Palace
• Quinta da Regaleira
• Cabo da Roca
• Sunset in Cascais
days.gem: The Initiation Well at Quinta da Regaleira.
days.noon:
• Quinta da Regaleira
• Bus 403 to Cabo da Roca
days.evening: • Seafood dinner in Cascais, train back
days.tips: • Go on a weekday – Sintra gets very busy

notes.advice: If you can, swap with a weekday – queues are much shorter.

shop.title: Tinned fish & ceramics
shop.body:
• Conserveira de Lisboa
• Vista Alegre for porcelain

tips.title: Viva Viagem card
tips.body: • Load it with 'Zapping' credit – works on metro, trams, buses and trains to Sintra and Cascais
